title: Console ownership revision candidates
hint: Review the exact ownership revision before activating it. Activation is bound to the digest shown here, and Core rechecks your Owner role and that digest before anything changes. No GitHub App or pull request is involved.
unavailable: Ownership revision candidates are unavailable. No activation was attempted.
empty: No ownership revision candidates are waiting for review.
queued: Activation queued. It takes effect only after Core verifies your Owner role and the digest.
forbidden: Only an Owner can activate an ownership revision.
failed: Activation could not be queued. Nothing was changed.
